title: Distinguish isomers and conformers
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.

statement:
Which description applies to staggered and eclipsed ethane?

[_]{a}

explanations: The orientation differs without changed connectivity.
Electron redistribution alone does not describe this change in positions.
